reviews.author: G G
reviews.text:
Great place to have my Peugeot repaired or oil changed.  Very knowledgeable and fast.
Normally people avoid dealerships for service, but this one is better than any repair shop out there. I had one issue several other repair refused to look at and others couldn't fix it, but this dealership repair shop had it fixed very inexpensively.  Always go back here.

reviews.author: PORTIER Gilles
reviews.text: Bad news with issue with my 807.  Despite the complex period of August with team reduced due to holidays, perfect service. Part ordered and delivered in 24 hours, car ready in 48 hrs. Good service with smile and understanding.

reviews.author: Allen Kent
reviews.text: Brilliant service, All climate, blower and heating/demist packed up whilst on holiday, called in un-announced and had it looked at, repaired fully in 24 hours, great service very friendly, French reg' car driven by Brit's in Spain, gotta expect trouble. Bibiana Martinez, service reception was brilliant. I was lucky with warranty, but it's a main dealer, expect to pay the going rate.

reviews.author: Mark Tullett
reviews.text: Great receptionist and the car was ready in great time after its annual revision
